title: South Florida Fall Weekend Guide
igCaption:
Beer, live music, sculpture, and skating under palms.
Dates and prices vary by venue.

Sources: Florida International University, Palm Beach Illustrated, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #WeekendGuide #FallInMiami

scenes.text: Want a fall weekend plan with beer, live music, sculpture, and ice skating under palms?
North Miami BrewFest takes place next month. Florida International University had it on the calendar on October 15, so this is a local beer stop to keep on your list.
scenes.caption: North Miami BrewFest takes place next month. FIU had it on the calendar on Oct. 15, so this is a local beer stop to keep on your list.

scenes.text: Adam Hawley plays Crazy Uncle Mike’s. Palm Beach Illustrated posted the show on October 15, and the venue puts live music in the middle of dinner and drinks.
scenes.caption: Adam Hawley plays Crazy Uncle Mike’s. Palm Beach Illustrated posted the show on Oct. 15, and the venue puts live music in the middle of dinner and drinks.

scenes.text: Ann Norton Sculpture Gardens unveils a Bruce Helander exhibition. The gardens are in West Palm Beach, and this adds an art stop to the weekend. At Ann Norton, peek on NEAR and see who else wandered the gardens.
scenes.caption: Ann Norton Sculpture Gardens unveils a Bruce Helander exhibition. The gardens are in West Palm Beach, and this adds an art stop to the weekend. At Ann Norton, peek on NEAR and see who else wandered the gardens.

scenes.text: NightGarden opens November 12 at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden. The event runs 60 minutes, welcomes all ages, and children 3 and under enter free. This year also adds a brand-new ice rink under the palms.
scenes.caption: NightGarden opens Nov. 12 at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden. The event runs 60 minutes, welcomes all ages, and children 3 and under enter free. This year also adds a brand-new ice rink under the palms.

scenes.text: Beer, music, art, or skating. You can spend the whole weekend crossing paths with someone at a beer garden, art walk, or rink and never learn their name, which is exactly what NEAR catches. Which one are you doing first?
